subject: CloudBridge vendor onboarding & PO integration
messages:
From: CloudBridge Procurement <procurement@cloudbridge.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + PO requirements for CloudBridge listing

Hi Irene,

Thanks for agreeing to help us get Redwood listed on the CloudBridge Marketplace. Procurement asked me to send the initial intake so your finance and legal teams have what they need. Please confirm the following so we can route the PO correctly: 

- Do invoices need the Marketplace PO number (we generally require it for billing automation)?
- Preferred remit-to address and billing contact (email + phone).
- Any vendor form we should complete on your side (W9, supplier profile, bank details)?
- Are you able to accept CloudBridge's standard MSA or do you need to sign separately through DocuSign?

I've attached CloudBridge_PO_template.pdf with the typical fields we need on invoices. Also attaching a W-9 request form to indicate where to upload bank info.

Can you loop in the person who owns marketplace procurement at Redwood? We need to get this live by mid-July.

Thanks,
Carmen Reyes
CloudBridge Procurement
procurement@cloudbridge.io

Attachment: CloudBridge_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: CloudBridge_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: CloudBridge Procurement <procurement@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + PO requirements for CloudBridge listing

Hi Carmen — thanks for the deck and heads up. Looping in Vanessa (Marketplaces / GTM) and Marcus (Finance ops) to own the billing and vendor intake pieces. Quick answers to your checklist below; Marcus, please correct if I miss anything.

- Marketplace PO on invoices: yes — we require the CloudBridge PO number to be present in the invoice header (field: "Marketplace PO"). This helps our AP automation.
- Preferred remit: Redwood Inference, Attn: AP, 1201 Third St, San Francisco, CA 94107. Billing contact: ap-billing@redwood.com / +1 (415) 555-0123.
- Vendor forms: we can accept the W-9 and bank details via secure upload. I've attached our internal vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx which lists required documents (W-9, supplier profile, bank redaction).
- Contracting: we normally execute marketplace listings with a short addendum plus our commercial terms. If CloudBridge requires your standard MSA we can route to Legal, otherwise DocuSign link is fine.

Vanessa — can you confirm the marketplace onboarding flow (AWS/Azure/GCP differences) and whether we need any extra commercial appendix? Marcus — please confirm invoice fields and whether we need to create a vendor record prior to PO.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.ms-excel)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + PO requirements for CloudBridge listing

Thanks — quick finance notes for the thread.

- Yes, AP needs the Marketplace PO number in the invoice body and on the PDF filename if possible (e.g., CB-PO-12345_invoice.pdf).
- Billing contact and remit-to as Irene listed are fine. We'll create a vendor record once we receive the completed W-9 and the redacted bank details.
- For marketplace billing: AWS Marketplace and Azure Marketplace use different fulfillment paths. For AWS we typically receive a consolidated monthly invoice from AWS if the seller is a marketplace publisher; that requires us to map AWS internal invoice IDs to the CloudBridge PO. For GCP there is a direct PO path. To avoid friction, CloudBridge should include a clear mapping field or our AP contact should receive an invoice that includes both the CloudBridge PO and any marketplace reference IDs.

I've attached a short note with our marketplace billing recommendations (aws_azure_gcp_billing_notes.md).

Next steps: Carmen — please upload signed W-9 and bank info. Once we have those I will send a vendor setup confirmation and provide the internal vendor id and invoice routing instructions.

Marcus Lin
Manager, Finance Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Attachment: aws_azure_gcp_billing_notes.md (text/markdown)

Thanks for the quick responses. Per your checklist we've attached the completed W-9 and our redacted bank details. We will also include the CloudBridge PO reference on any invoice we submit.

Attachments: CloudBridge_W9.pdf, bank_details_redacted.pdf

Regarding contracting: we can sign the addendum via DocuSign. Here's the link to the DocuSign envelope for the listing MSA addendum: https://docusign.com/xyz/CB-contract-4521. Please let us know who should be the signer from Redwood and we'll kick it off.

We'd like to target go-live for July 15 if possible. Let us know if that timeline works for setup and approval.

Best,
Carmen Reyes

2) Vanessa will run the marketplace enablement checklist and confirm whether an appendix is required for CloudBridge listing (target: 48 hours).

Timeline: July 15 go-live is tight but feasible. If Marcus can create the vendor record today and Legal signs within 48 hours we should meet the date. Carmen — please confirm when you kickoff DocuSign and I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan.

Thanks all — Irene
